youtube.baslik: Why ask about the heart in a child with congenital severe loss? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Jervell and Lange-Nielsen syndrome, congenital, bilateral, severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss comes with a long QT interval on the electrocardiogram. The potassium channel encoded by the KCNQ1 and KCNE1 genes works both in the cells of the stria vascularis and in heart muscle. So ask about fainting with exercise or excitement and sudden death at a young age in the family; the electrocardiogram and treatment decisions belong to the physician.
